name: Oriah Mountain Dreamer
reason: Own site oriah.org (found via her Monkfish publisher page) is dormant: its newsletter archive stops at January 2014 and its schedule page says she 'is not currently travelling, teaching or facilitating workshops' and is focused on writing. No courses, events or downloads of her own; only books (HarperOne titles The Invitation, The Dance, The Call) and a blogspot blog. With no current offerings and no sign the email (mail@oriah.org) or base still apply, too thin to list. Could be revisited if she resumes teaching.
